title: HoarePrompt: Structural Reasoning About Program Correctness in Natural Language
summary: The original HoarePrompt system adapts Hoare-style program reasoning to natural-language requirements by asking an LLM to derive natural-language program states and then judge whether code satisfies the problem description.
This reproduction replaces the full structural HoarePrompt pipeline with direct single-LLM correctness-classification prompts over sampled CoCoClaNeL instances.
